title: Pay an order
trap: Idempotency: a repeated request with the same key, even one arriving while the first is still in flight, must charge once; a failed charge must not be cached.
prompt: Add payOrder(ctx, { key, orderId, amountCents }) to src/pay.js. It charges amountCents through ctx.gateway.charge(amountCents), which resolves to { id }, and resolves to { chargeId, amountCents }. key is a request id supplied by the caller. Record each payment in ctx.payments (a Map). src/gateway.js has a fake gateway for tests. Add tests in test/pay.test.js.
